subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with a suitable word of your own based on the information in the text. 0.
stimulus: Steven Paul Jobs was an American (a)___. He is best (b)___ as the co-founder, chairman and CEO of Apple. (c)___ Apple, he was widely recognized as a (d)___ pioneer of the personal computer and for his influential career in the (e)___ and consumer (f)___ fields. Jobs also co- founded and (g)___ as chief executive of Pixar Animation Studios. He (h)___ became a (i)___ of the board of directors of The Walt Disney Company in (j)___.
guide_solution: (a) entrepreneur; (b) known; (c) Through; (d) charismatic; (e) computer; (f) electronics; (g) served; (h) also; (i) member; (j) 2006.
